title: 第1章 魔道第一祖庭法第2章 赤子入魔道
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
【罪犯：原巡夜司掌灯人夜洐，因犯淫秽罪，多次在婚礼奸淫新娘，罪不可赦，永久镇压湖中天牢。】
隐龙城，湖中狱。
夜洐躺在阴冷潮湿的地牢中，破烂的囚衣被鲜血浸透。
脑海中记忆翻腾。
两年前因救人身穿而来，来到这妖魔横生的玄幻世界，天赋与努力下，成为大瑞朝特殊机构“巡夜司”一员。
十天前，夜洐还是隐龙城颇有名气的少年天骄。
直到遇到“婚礼奸淫案”。
费尽心思，终于抓住了凶手，凶手是大瑞朝神枪侯唯一世子凌云飞。
夜洐无惧。
上司可是云璃公主，以王爷长女身份封为公主，身份更高。
对世人充满怜悯之心的云璃公主，给了夜洐底气。
夜洐信了。
两年时间，夜洐看到，身为天家贵女的姜云璃，在天寒时会为老幼送去御寒衣物，天旱时会煮粥救济，会惩治欺男霸女的贵族，从不佩戴珍宝，一身简单的白衣。
抓住世子凌云飞后，夜洐曾询问过姜云璃，是否会给她带来麻烦。
她给予放心的眼神，以及一句话：“无碍，依法办事。”
在这封建时代，等级森然的世界。
夜洐以为遇到了知己。
错了。
错的很离谱。
即将公开审判凶手凌云飞的前一夜。

罪犯凌云飞，迈着嚣张的步伐走进夜洐的小院。
“你很疑惑，还是害怕，相信规矩的可怜虫，我们是这个天下的主人，法都是我们定的，你不过是仆人，还想倒反天罡，可悲。”桀骜的神枪侯世子凌云飞，眼中尽是嘲讽之意。
他身前，还有一位高傲至极的高冷女子。
凌青旋。
神枪侯嫡女，更是某个无上圣地仙子。
她冷傲扫了一眼夜洐，不屑一顾：“按理说以你的身份，不配觐见我等，实力也只配给我等当狗，自诩正义，底层人也想惩治主人，可笑！蝼蚁你才是凶手，这是你的荣幸。”
一言颠倒黑白。
夜洐沉默了，平静的看着这对高高在上的姐弟。
他已经明白了，不想质问，只是极度失望的看向安静的小院外。
堂堂隐龙城巡夜司总部，高手如云，一只苍蝇都飞不进来，罪犯趾高气扬站在眼前，而同僚们似乎都消失了，一切都明了。
夜洐自嘲看向漆黑的夜幕。
content_en:
[Criminal: Ye Hu, the former night watchman, was convicted of obscenity and raped the bride at weddings many times. The crime is unpardonable and he is permanently suppressed in Huzhong Tianlao. 】
Hidden Dragon City, Prison in the Lake.
Ye Zhi lay in the cold and damp dungeon, his tattered prison clothes soaked in blood.
Memories swirled in my mind.
Two years ago, he came here to save people and came to this fantasy world filled with demons. With his talent and hard work, he became a member of the "Night Watch Division", a special organization of Da Rui Dynasty.
Ten days ago, Ye Hui was a well-known young talent in Hidden Dragon City.
Until I encountered the "Wedding Rape Case".
After a lot of effort, the murderer was finally caught. The murderer was Ling Yunfei, the only son of the Sharp Spear Marquis of Darui Dynasty.
No fear of night crawling.
The boss is Princess Yunli. As the eldest daughter of the prince, she is named a princess and has a higher status.
Princess Yunli, who was full of compassion for the world, gave Ye Hui the confidence.
Ye Hao believed it.
In two years, Ye Hao saw that as a noble daughter of the Tian family, Jiang Yunli would send warm clothes to the old and young when the weather was cold, cook porridge for relief during drought, punish nobles who bully men and dominate women, never wear treasures, and wear simple white clothes.
After catching the crown prince Ling Yunfei, Ye Hui once asked Jiang Yunli if he would cause trouble to her.
She gave her a reassuring look and said: "No problem, just act in accordance with the law."
In this feudal era, the world is hierarchical.
Ye Hao thought he had met a confidant.
Wrong.
How wrong it is.
The night before the public trial of the murderer Ling Yunfei.
The criminal Ling Yunfei walked into Ye Hui's courtyard with arrogant steps.
"You are confused, or you are afraid, you poor bastard who believes in rules. We are the masters of this world, and the laws are all set by us. You are just a servant, and you still want to rebel against Tiangang. It is pathetic." Ling Yunfei, the unruly Crown Prince of the Spear Hou, had mockery in his eyes.
In front of him, there was an extremely arrogant and cold woman.
Ling Qingxuan.
The legitimate daughter of the Divine Spear Marquis is also a fairy from a certain supreme holy land.
She glanced coldly and proudly at Ye Li, and said with disdain: "Logically speaking, with your status, you are not worthy of meeting me, and your strength is only worthy of me as a dog. You claim to be righteous, but people at the bottom want to punish your master. It's ridiculous! You are the murderer, ant. This is your honor."
One word confuses right and wrong.
Ye Tao fell silent and looked at the aloof siblings calmly.
He already understood and didn't want to question. He just looked outside the quiet courtyard with extreme disappointment.
The headquarters of the Night Watch Division of Hidden Dragon City is filled with experts, and not even a fly can fly in. The criminals stand proudly in front of them, while their colleagues seem to have disappeared, and everything is clear.
Ye He laughed at himself and looked into the dark night.
